snippet.title: Ned Luke ROASTS Fan Who Killed Michael! 😂 GTA V Cast Q&A
snippet.description:
⚠️ STRONG LANGUAGE WARNING: This panel contains frequent strong and very strong language, including some colourful contributions from the GTA cast! Not suitable for younger viewers.

The cast of Grand Theft Auto V and GTA: San Andreas answer fan questions at MCM London Comic Con 2026, revealing deleted GTA V content, motion-capture disasters, their thoughts on GTA VI, and some absolutely hilarious behind-the-scenes stories! 🎮

Ned Luke (Michael De Santa), Shawn Fonteno (Franklin Clinton), Steven Ogg (Trevor Philips) and Young Maylay (CJ) take questions from the audience in Part 2 of our GTA cast panel.

And there are some fantastic revelations!

🐴 A DELETED GTA V MISSION! Ned and Steven reveal an entire sequence that never made it into the finished game, where Michael and Trevor pose as a couple looking at property before things escalate into stealing a horse! The cast explain how they spent days filming it, only for problems with animating the horse to derail the mission.

🐕 CHOP THE DOG! Shawn reveals what happened when Rockstar brought a real dog onto the motion-capture stage, and why the original animal wasn't quite as cooperative as everyone hoped. Plus, the rather wonderful sight of a dog wearing a motion-capture suit!

🎮 GTA VI! The cast share their advice for the actors taking over as the new leads in Grand Theft Auto VI, including how to handle the enormous Rockstar fanbase and the attention that comes with being part of such a huge franchise.

😂 FRANKLIN'S FAMOUS "WHAT?" Shawn explains why Franklin says "What?" so frequently throughout GTA V, and the reason is considerably simpler than you might expect!

💀 KILLING MICHAEL! A fan admits choosing Ending B in GTA V, where Franklin kills Michael. Unfortunately, Ned Luke is sitting right in front of him, and he's not particularly impressed with that decision!

🎤 YOUNG MAYLAY & SAMUEL L. JACKSON! A fan asks what it was like working with Samuel L. Jackson on GTA: San Andreas, leading to a rather surprising answer about how video game voice recording actually works.

❤️ BEHIND THE SCENES! Shawn explains how uncomfortable he felt recording the endings where Michael and Trevor die, while Ned recalls the scene that earned Shawn a standing ovation from the production crew.

🎬 FAVOURITE MOMENTS! The cast discuss their favourite missions, unforgettable dialogue, the enormous range of GTA fans they've met, and why these games have remained so important for so many years.

There's also a particularly funny moment when a fan dressed as Spider-Man asks whether any of the actors will appear in GTA VI, only to receive a rather direct response from Ned!

From hidden GTA V content to the relationships formed during production, this is a fantastic collection of stories from four actors who helped create some of gaming's most memorable characters.

This is Part 2 of our two-part GTA panel coverage from MCM London Comic Con, October 2026.

Watch Part 1 on the Geektown YouTube channel, featuring Shawn Fonteno's story about nearly quitting GTA V, Steven Ogg's hilarious acting discussion, and the cast playing Existential Chicken!

snippet.title: Steven Ogg Steals the Show! GTA V Cast Panel & Existential Chicken 😂
snippet.description:
⚠️ STRONG LANGUAGE WARNING: This panel contains frequent strong and very strong language, including some colourful contributions from the GTA cast! Not suitable for younger viewers.

The cast of Grand Theft Auto V and GTA: San Andreas reunite at MCM London Comic Con 2026 for an absolutely hilarious panel packed with behind-the-scenes stories, acting revelations, and a chaotic game of Existential Chicken! 🎮

Join Ned Luke (Michael De Santa), Shawn Fonteno (Franklin Clinton), Steven Ogg (Trevor Philips) and Young Maylay (Carl "CJ" Johnson), with host WeeClaire, for Part 1 of our GTA cast panel.

In this video:

🎮 Shawn Fonteno reveals why he nearly QUIT GTA V! From struggling with motion capture to memorising huge amounts of dialogue, Shawn explains how close he came to walking away before he even knew he was working on Grand Theft Auto.

🎭 Ned Luke recalls the moment Shawn finally found his confidence as an actor, during the emotional scene where Michael confesses to Franklin that he's been working with the FIB.

🎤 Young Maylay looks back at recording GTA: San Andreas, working under Dan Houser, and why he hasn't pursued other video game roles.

🎬 Ned Luke and Steven Ogg discuss their incredible chemistry as Michael and Trevor, including the challenges of performance capture, improvisation, and bringing Rockstar's writing to life.

😂 Steven Ogg explains what makes a great acting partner, before launching into a hilarious demonstration of people who make every sentence sound like a question. Ned and WeeClaire naturally make the situation considerably worse!

🐔 EXISTENTIAL CHICKEN! The cast tackle questions from Gilbert the rubber chicken, including who would be the final boss of their lives, their most useless talents, and what warning label Steven Ogg should come with.

It's a brilliantly entertaining look at the people behind some of gaming's most iconic characters, with plenty of swearing, laughter and the sort of chaos you'd expect when Trevor, Michael, Franklin and CJ all share a sofa!

This is Part 1 of our two-part GTA panel coverage from MCM London Comic Con, October 2026.

Watch Part 2 on the Geektown YouTube channel, where the cast answer fan questions about GTA VI, reveal a deleted GTA V mission involving Michael and Trevor, explain why Chop the dog caused problems during motion capture, and much more!

snippet.title: Michael's Actor Had To Win An Act-Off 😳
snippet.description:
Ned Luke, the voice and face of Michael De Santa in GTA 5, says his callback was an "act-off": Rockstar brought in two Michaels and two Trevors. Then the casting team handed out seven pages of brand-new material, and the other Michael panicked. Ned and Steven Ogg threw down the scripts, went physical, and Ned told Steve on the way out that he was getting the part. He did.

Credits:
Interview: Dan Allen Gaming Clips, "Ned Luke on Crazy GTA 5 Audition Process with Steven Ogg" https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=moimtF6A3Jc (clips from 0:52 to 5:32)
Gameplay: GTA Series Videos, "GTA 5 PS5 - Mission #56 - Bury the Hatchet [Gold Medal Guide - 4K 60fps]" https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ur6elRujPZA
Gameplay: GTA Series Videos, "GTA 5 PS5 - Mission #1 - Prologue [Gold Medal Guide - 4K 60fps]" https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eVtEKMUp08s
Voiceover hook, original music and sound effects generated with ElevenLabs. Edit, captions and sound design by Usenji.

Could anyone else have played Michael and Trevor? 👇

snippet.title: I Interviewed Steven Ogg (Trevor From GTA 5)
snippet.description:
I got the amazing opportunity to interview Steven Ogg (Trevor) from GTA 5, and the story didn't end there. Steven invited me to Comic-Con Midlands the following weekend, where I got to meet him, Ned Luke (Michael) and Shawn Fonteno (Franklin) in person. In this video I share the full interview plus everything that happened when we met face to face, including a secret code name reveal and a haircut nobody saw coming.

If you enjoyed this, subscribe for more gaming content and my takes on the games industry.
